# Application-arm source snapshot 2026-08-10

The immutable source bundle is stored locally in `bundle/` and excluded from Git because it is approximately 1.0 GB.

The snapshot keeps its original internal layout so bundled configs continue to resolve. It must not be edited in place. New normalized data, coverage reports, and acquisition outputs belong outside `bundle/`.

Integrity was verified before relocation with the supplied `FILE_MANIFEST_SHA256.txt`. All 2,174 listed files passed SHA256 verification. Provenance commit: `e22ae233c097f3d05d2c850446dc60c4194942b1`.
